name: 86406 · Lk Havasu Cty, AZ
findings: ZIP 86406 (Lk Havasu Cty) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 86406 (Lk Havasu Cty) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 86406 (Lk Havasu Cty) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).
